job.job_description:
We are responsible for designing, developing, and implementing next generation data platforms to drive incremental revenue.

Key Responsibilities:

Generative AI & Innovation

Lead the design, development, and deployment of GenAI solutions, including LLM integration, prompt engineering, RAG systems, and domain-specific model customization.
Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and prototype innovative solutions to accelerate business transformation.
Drive experimentation frameworks that validate model performance, user experience impact, and production feasibility.

Analytical & Data-Driven Applications

Architect and build data-intensive analytical applications that enable real-time insights, predictive intelligence, and automated decisioning.
Partner with data engineering teams to design scalable data pipelines, metadata systems, and high-quality feature stores.
Ensure analytical systems meet enterprise requirements for accuracy, governance, and performance.

Enterprise-Scale Engineering

Architect cloud-native applications capable of handling large-scale,high-availability workloads.
Oversee performance optimization, distributed processing, caching strategies, and operational monitoring.
Ensure secure, compliant, and resilient engineering practices aligned with enterprise standards.

Microservices Architecture

Design and evolve microservices architectures using best practices such as domain-driven design, event-driven patterns, and API-first development.
Implement robust inter-service communication (REST, gRPC, messaging) and reliability patterns (circuit breakers, rate limiting).
Guide engineers on scaling, testing, and maintaining distributed services.

Leadership & Collaboration

Mentor engineering and data science teams in modern AI, GenAI adoption, and architectural excellence.
Translate business goals into actionable engineering roadmaps and AI solution blueprints.
Define coding standards, architecture guidelines, model governance, and delivery best practices.
Collaborate closely with product, security, and platform teams to align AI solutions with enterprise strategy

Qualifications

Basic Qualifications:10+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelors Degree or at least 7 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e g Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 4 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 13+ years of relevant work experience
Preferred Qualifications:12 or more years of work experience with a Bachelors Degree or 8-10 years of experience with an Advanced Degree (e g Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 6+ years of work experience with a PhD1214 years of software engineering experience, including significant leadership in AI/ML and GenAI initiatives
Expertise in LLMs, embeddings, RAG systems, model fine tuning, and GenAI frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face, etc )
Strong proficiency in Python plus enterprise languages (Java/Scala/Go)
Experience building scalable cloud-native systems (AWS, Azure, GCP) and microservices architectures
Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and observability tools
Deep understanding of MLOps practices, model lifecycle management, and production AI monitoring
Proven ability to deliver large-scale analytical applications and distributed data workflows
Strong leadership, communication, and cross-functional collaboration skills
